run_extract_pa_masks: run the CLI tool to extract pixel adjacency masks from a trained MMDetection model checkpoint
run_single_gpu_test: run single GPU inference to extract top-k PA masks with IoU scores against ground truth
run_multi_gpu_test: run distributed multi-GPU inference to extract PA masks across a dataset with result collection
run_proposals2json: run the function to convert PA mask arrays into COCO-style JSON annotations with RLE encoding
run_replace_filename_by_id: run the function to replace image filenames with COCO image IDs in extracted proposal results
